title: Aharonov-Casher phase in twisted bilayer graphene
summary: The Aharonov-Casher (AC) effect is a quantum mechanical phenomenon in which the wave function of a particle with a magnetic moment moving in a region subject to an electric field develops a phase shift due to spin-orbit interaction, even if no classical force acts on it. This phase also depends on the medium through which the particle moves. Here we focus on the AC phase of an electron moving in twisted bilayer graphene (TBG) lying in the $x$-$y$ plane, subject to a uniform electric field perpendicular to the plane of the graphene, ${\bf E}=E{\hat{\bf z}}$. The AC phase is determined by an $SU(2)$ vector potential ${\bf A}$ from which a phase factor is generated, and used to perform a gauge transformation of the Hamiltonian. We find that the AC phase is linear with $E$ and exhibits sharp peaks at the magic angles.

AI.tldr: 研究发现在扭曲双层石墨烯中，电子的Aharonov-Casher相位与电场强度呈线性关系，并在魔角处出现尖锐峰值。
AI.motivation: 探索在扭曲双层石墨烯这一特定材料体系中，AC相位的特性及其与魔角的关系。
AI.method: 通过SU(2)规范势构造AC相位因子，对哈密顿量进行规范变换，分析电场垂直施加于石墨烯平面时电子的AC相位。
AI.result: AC相位与电场E呈线性关系，并在魔角处出现尖锐峰值。
AI.conclusion: 扭曲双层石墨烯的魔角显著影响AC相位，揭示了自旋-轨道耦合与能带拓扑之间的关联。

title: Gravity-controlled non-equilibrium Casimir pressure in a binary liquid mixture
summary: We investigate the non-equilibrium Casimir pressure in an isothermal binary liquid mixture maintained in a spatially constant and stationary concentration gradient parallel to gravity and confined within a three-dimensional slab of thickness $L$, bounded by two infinite plates parallel to both the gravitational field and the imposed gradient. We assume that the liquid mixture, under the same non-equilibrium conditions, occupies both the interior and the exterior of the slab. Using fluctuating hydrodynamics, we show that the resulting finite-size excess pressure on the plates is described by a scaling function of the dimensionless variable $k_{\mathrm{RO}}L$, where $k_{\mathrm{RO}}$ is the gravity-induced roll-off wavevector. At large separations, this Casimir pressure decays as $1/(k_{\mathrm{RO}}L)$. Depending on the thermodynamic properties of the mixture, the corresponding force can be either attractive or repulsive, while it vanishes for ideal solutions. Since the mixture is assumed to be far from its consolute critical point, the Casimir pressure investigated here is entirely of non-equilibrium origin and it vanishes in the absence of the imposed concentration gradient. Finally, we propose an experimental setup where this force might be measured, consisting of two optically trapped colloidal particles immersed in a dense aqueous colloidal suspension diffusing into an overlying layer of pure water, estimating the expected magnitude of the resulting force.

AI.tldr: 本文研究等温二元液体混合物在恒定浓度梯度与重力场共同作用下产生的非平衡Casimir压力，发现其随板间距以1/(k_RO L)衰减，力可为吸引或排斥，并提出了实验测量方案。
AI.motivation: 探索非平衡态下由浓度梯度和重力共同诱导的Casimir-like力，填补非平衡Casimir效应在液体混合物中的研究空白。
AI.method: 采用涨落流体动力学理论，分析三维平板间二元混合物的非平衡浓度涨落，推导出有限尺寸对平板的超额压力。
AI.result: 非平衡Casimir压力随分离距离增大按1/(k_RO L)衰减；力可吸引或可排斥，取决于热力学性质；对理想溶液为零；完全源于非平衡浓度梯度。
AI.conclusion: 该非平衡Casimir力是纯粹的浓度梯度驱动效应，远离临界点，并提出基于光学捕获胶体粒子的实验方案以验证其存在和量级。

title: Anisotropic domain wall velocity profiles in the creep regime: the interplay of chiral damping, stiffness and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction
summary: The asymmetric expansion of magnetic bubble domains in ultrathin ferromagnets provides a powerful route to probe the interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI). While conventional analyses rely on domain wall velocities measured along selected directions as a function of in-plane field, recent approaches have highlighted the additional insight contained in the angular dependence of the velocity, $v(θ)$. Here, we develop an extended angular creep model that incorporates both the dispersive domain wall stiffness and a chirality-dependent prefactor associated with chiral damping. This generalization captures the full anisotropic dynamics of domain wall motion around a bubble domain. We show that these contributions significantly modify the angular velocity profile and can lead to features not accessible within existing models. Our results establish a more complete framework for interpreting creep-driven domain expansion and provide improved sensitivity for the quantitative extraction of DMI and chiral dynamical effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种扩展的角蠕变模型，用于解释超薄铁磁体中磁泡畴的不对称膨胀，该模型同时考虑了色散畴壁刚度和与手性阻尼相关的手性依赖前因子，从而更完整地描述了畴壁运动的各向异性动力学，并提高了对Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）和手性动力学效应的定量提取灵敏度。
AI.motivation: 现有模型通过沿选定方向的畴壁速度来分析DMI，但忽略了角速度分布v(θ)中包含的额外信息。作者旨在建立一个更完整的框架，以捕捉角蠕变过程中完整的各向异性动力学，从而改进DMI及手性动力学效应的定量提取。
AI.method: 作者开发了一个扩展的角蠕变模型，该模型整合了两个关键因素：一是色散畴壁刚度（dispersive domain wall stiffness），二是与手性阻尼（chiral damping）相关的手性依赖前因子（chirality-dependent prefactor），从而推广了传统的分析方法，能够完整描述磁泡畴周围畴壁运动的各向异性角速度分布。
AI.result: 结果表明，色散畴壁刚度和手性依赖前因子显著改变了角速度分布轮廓，并可能产生现有模型无法解释的新特征。该模型为解释蠕变驱动的畴域扩张提供了更完整的框架。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一个更全面的理论框架，提升了从磁泡畴不对称膨胀中定量提取DMI和手性动力学效应的灵敏度，为相关实验分析提供了更精确的工具。

title: Identifying Contact Barrier Types in Few-Layer MoS2 Devices Using Correlative IV, LBIC, and Bias-Dependent KPFM
summary: Electrical contacts between metals and two-dimensional (2D) semiconductors such as molybdenum disulfide (MoS2) critically govern device performance, yet their microscopic nature remains difficult to disentangle using any single characterization technique. Here we present an integrated experimental framework that combines current-voltage (IV) characterization, laser beam induced current (LBIC) mapping, and bias-dependent Kelvin probe force microscopy (KPFM) to comprehensively resolve the contact properties of few-layer MoS2-based two-terminal devices under ambient conditions. IV measurements deliver macroscopic transport characteristics as a function of bias voltage and illumination conditions. LBIC maps the local photocurrent response with micrometer spatial resolution, revealing the position and nature of internal electric fields at MoS2-metal interfaces. KPFM, operated under an applied static bias rather than in the conventional work-function mode, provides nanoscale-resolved potential distributions that quantify the relative magnitudes and spatial locations of contact barriers. We apply this framework to three representative devices - one exhibiting ohmic-like and two exhibiting diode-like contact behavior - and demonstrate that the combined analysis can unambiguously identify whether the dominant barrier is of Schottky or tunnel type and determine the asymmetry between the two contacts. We further demonstrate that thermal annealing significantly reduces the total resistance, while contact barriers remain the dominant source of resistance. The methodology is directly transferable to other 2D semiconductor-metal systems and provides a practical yet comprehensive route toward a quantitative microscopic understanding of 2D device contacts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种集成实验框架，结合IV表征、LBIC映射和偏置依赖KPFM，全面解析了少层MoS2器件中金属-二维半导体接触的微观特性，能够明确区分肖特基势垒和隧穿势垒，并揭示接触不对称性。
AI.motivation: 金属与二维半导体（如MoS2）之间的电接触关键决定器件性能，但单一表征技术难以解析其微观性质，亟需一种综合性的实验方法。
AI.method: 集成IV表征（宏观输运特性）、LBIC映射（微米级光电流成像，揭示内建电场位置与性质）以及偏置依赖KPFM（纳米级势垒分布定量分析），对三种代表性器件（欧姆接触型、两种二极管型）进行综合分析。
AI.result: 框架能明确识别主导势垒类型（肖特基或隧穿）及接触不对称性；热退火显著降低总电阻，但接触势垒仍是主要电阻来源。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可直接推广至其他二维半导体-金属体系，为实现对二维器件接触的定量微观理解提供了实用且全面的途径。

title: Kinetically induced order from mobility-constrained excitations
comment: 5 pages of main text with 2 figures, and Supplementary material
summary: A fascinating feature of strongly correlated systems is that excitations may carry nontrivial quantum numbers under emergent symmetries which, in some cases, may strongly constrain their motion. We show that such constrained excitations can play a central role in driving symmetry-breaking long-range order through a kinetic mechanism: coupling to a local order-parameter field activates the mobility of otherwise constrained excitations, and condensation of the order parameter then enables a large gain in kinetic energy, thereby stabilizing a phase with long-range order. We illustrate this mechanism in two settings: (i) a dimerization instability in a spin chain with a magnetization dipole conservation law, and (ii) itinerant magnetism of electrons in the Kitaev-Kondo model, where charge carriers couple to local moments that form a spin liquid. This mechanism becomes operative whenever a finite density of mobility-constrained excitations is present, either through non-equilibrium preparation or thermal activation. In the latter case, we argue that increasing temperature can, counterintuitively, promote order by enhancing the kinetic-energy gain of thermally activated excitations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种动力学机制：受约束的激发通过耦合到序参量场获得可移动性，其凝聚可带来巨大动能收益，从而驱动长程有序。通过自旋链二聚化和Kitaev-Kondo模型中的巡游磁性两个例子加以说明，并指出温度升高可能反常地促进这种有序。
AI.motivation: 强关联系统中受约束的激发（如携带非平庸对称性量子数的激发）如何驱动对称性破缺的长程有序，目前缺乏理解。作者希望阐明一种普适的动力学机制。
AI.method: 提出"动力学机制"：受约束的激发通过与局域序参量场耦合而激活其可移动性，序参量凝聚后带来巨大的动能增益，从而稳定长程有序相。通过两个模型（磁化偶极子守恒的自旋链中的二聚化不稳定性、Kitaev-Kondo模型中的巡游磁性）加以演示。
AI.result: 该机制在受约束激发具有有限密度时（通过非平衡制备或热激活）即可运作。温度升高可反常地增强热激活激发的动能收益，从而促进有序。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种普适的动力学有序化机制，其中受约束激发的可移动性激活是驱动长程有序的关键。该机制在有限温度下具有反直觉的效应，即升温可能促进而非破坏有序。

title: Macroscopic wall pressure and microscopic contact load in crowds without egress: social-group cohesion and boundary buffering
summary: Crowd safety in confined venues is usually evaluated through evacuation performance or pre-collision avoidance, while direct mechanical hazards in dense gatherings without egress remain poorly understood. We study an Elastic Reorientation Model (ERM), a Social Force Model (SFM), and their coupled dynamics. Post-collision behavior is represented by social-group cohesion ($γ_g$) and wall buffering ($γ_w$), while risk is quantified by the macroscopic wall line pressure ($P_{\text{wall}}$) and the microscopic maximum per-agent collision impulse ($δp_{\text{max}}$). In the ERM, cohesion and wall buffering generally reduce $P_{\text{wall}}$ by retaining agents in the bulk, but large groups exhibit a high-$δp_{\text{max}}$ hazard window at intermediate cohesion. As $γ_g\rightarrow1$, local pairing suppresses cluster growth and shifts kinetic energy from relative to center-of-mass motion, reducing $δp_{\text{max}}$. SFM pushing and sliding amplify $δp_{\text{max}}$, especially when agent-agent and agent-wall interactions coexist, while active driving raises $P_{\text{wall}}$ through near-wall accumulation. The coupled dynamics produces a wall-pressure/contact-load ($P$-$p$) trade-off. Finite-size scaling reveals an independent-agent-induced phase boundary at $γ_w=0.5$, characterized by a susceptibility discontinuity, and a grouped-agent-induced continuous phase boundary along a finite segment of $(1-γ_w)(1-γ_g)=0.5$, characterized by divergent susceptibility and terminating at a critical point. Both disappear in the social-force-free ERM, showing that they emerge from the coupled ERM+SFM dynamics. These results provide mechanistic guidance for crowd-risk mitigation and safety planning in high-density venues without egress.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了密集人群中缺乏疏散通道时的直接机械危险，通过弹性重定向模型(ERM)和社会力模型(SFM)的耦合动力学，分析了群体凝聚力与墙缓冲对碰撞风险的影响，发现了耦合动力学生成的相变边界和压力-冲击权衡关系，为高密度场所的人群安全规划提供了机理指导。
AI.motivation: 现有人群安全研究多聚焦于疏散性能或碰撞规避，而对密闭场所中无疏散通道时的直接机械危险（如挤压致伤）理解不足，缺乏相关风险评估方法。
AI.method: 采用弹性重定向模型(ERM)和社会力模型(SFM)及其耦合动力学，通过群体凝聚力(γ_g)和墙缓冲(γ_w)表征碰撞后行为，用宏观壁面线压力(P_wall)和微观最大碰撞冲量(δp_max)量化风险。
AI.result: ERM中凝聚力和墙缓冲降低P_wall但大群体在中等凝聚力时出现高δp_max风险窗口；γ_g→1时配对抑制簇增长降低δp_max；SFM推挤滑动放大δp_max；耦合动力学产生壁压-接触载荷权衡；发现独立-agent诱导相边界(γ_w=0.5)和分组-agent诱导连续相边界，两者仅存在于耦合ERM+SFM中。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了高密度人群无疏散场景下的机械危险机制，包括相变边界和风险权衡关系，为人群风险缓解和安全规划提供了机理层面的指导。

title: To Blink or Not to Blink? A New Criterion to Quantify Luminescence Blinking
summary: Colloidal semiconductor quantum dots are promising materials for numerous applications due to their tunable emission and high quantum yields. However, emission instability in the form of luminescence blinking remains a significant obstacle to their practical implementation. While recent advances in synthesis and surface engineering have demonstrated partial or complete blinking suppression, the quantitative assessment of the "quality" of this suppression remains challenging. Existing criteria typically rely on threshold-based classification into ON and OFF states, which becomes inherently ambiguous owing to the continuous distribution of emission intensities in single quantum dots. Here, we propose a threshold-free two-dimensional quantitative criterion based on the variance of the recombination rate and the relative quantum yield, both of which can be extracted from standard time-correlated single-photon counting measurements. We validate the criterion using simulated blinking trajectories covering all major blinking mechanisms and demonstrate that it cleanly separates them into distinct regions of the two-dimensional parameter space while providing a quantitative measure of the degree of suppression. This approach directly quantifies the temporal stability of emission without requiring arbitrary state definitions, thereby providing a robust metric for comparing different blinking suppression strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于复合速率方差和相对量子产率的无阈值二维定量标准，用于评估胶体半导体量子点的发光闪烁抑制效果，无需传统ON/OFF状态分类。
AI.motivation: 现有闪烁抑制评估依赖阈值分类ON/OFF态，但量子点发射强度呈连续分布，导致定义模糊，亟需无阈值的定量评价标准。
AI.method: 从标准时间相关单光子计数测量中提取复合速率方差和相对量子产率，构建二维参数空间，并通过模拟不同闪烁机制轨迹验证其区分能力。
AI.result: 该标准能清晰区分不同闪烁机制在二维空间中的区域，并定量衡量闪烁抑制程度，无需任意状态定义。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为比较不同闪烁抑制策略提供了鲁棒的定量指标，直接量化了发射的时间稳定性。

title: A Catalogue of Topological Moiré Bands in Twisted Semiconductors
summary: Twisted two-dimensional semiconductors provide a route to flat and topological moiré minibands, but systematic principles for organizing their material dependence have remained unclear. Here, we establish a high-throughput framework that integrates structural relaxation, first-principles electronic structure calculations, and moiré band topology. We apply this framework to 43 experimentally realized monolayers and 91 symmetry-inequivalent bilayer prototypes, yielding over 1,000 angle-resolved moiré electronic band structures. This database reveals that the low-energy moiré electronic structure is organized primarily by the valley character of the parent band edge together with stacking symmetry. In $Γ$-valley systems, the miniband width usually follows a nearly quadratic twist-angle scaling, consistent with a folding-dominated kinetic-energy scale. In $K$-valley systems, stacking-controlled interlayer hybridization governs whether parent Berry curvature is redistributed into isolated valley Chern minibands. By contrast, $M$-valley systems form a more material-specific class associated with anisotropic and symmetry-constrained band folding. The same valley-and-stacking hierarchy rationalizes the emergence or suppression of $\mathbb{Z}_2$ minibands, and surface termination in Janus bilayers provides a microscopic knob for changing the relevant valley character. These results establish a materials-level organizing principle for designing flat and topological moiré bands in twisted semiconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个高通量框架，对43种实验单层和91种双层原型进行系统分析，揭示了扭曲二维半导体中莫尔电子结构主要由母体带边的谷特性与堆叠对称性决定，提出了谷-堆叠层级组织原则。
AI.motivation: 扭曲二维半导体可以形成平坦和拓扑的莫尔微带，但缺乏系统性的材料依赖组织原则，阻碍了材料设计。
AI.method: 建立高通量计算框架，整合结构弛豫、第一性原理电子结构计算和莫尔能带拓扑分析，对43种实验单层和91种对称不等价双层原型进行计算，生成超过1000个角度分辨的莫尔电子能带结构。
AI.result: 发现低能莫尔电子结构主要由母体带边的谷特性（Γ、K、M）和堆叠对称性组织：Γ谷系统微带宽度呈近二次扭角标度；K谷系统由堆叠控制的层间杂化决定Berry曲率再分布；M谷系统更具材料特异性。该层级可解释Z2微带的出现或抑制，Janus双层的表面终止可调控谷特性。
AI.conclusion: 建立了扭曲半导体中平坦和拓扑莫尔带设计的材料级组织原则，为材料筛选和工程设计提供了系统性指导。

title: Scaling universal Fermi network toward ground states: A diffusion-Monte-Carlo assessment
summary: In this work, we show that Fermi Sets---a provably universal neural network architecture for fermionic wavefunctions---can be systematically scaled up to find interacting ground states through energy minimization in a variational Monte Carlo framework. By further performing fixed-phase diffusion Monte Carlo (DMC) on the optimized neural network wavefunction, we demonstrate that as the network size increases, the variational energy systematically decreases while the energy improvement from DMC collapses monotonically to zero, indicating convergence to the ground state. We illustrate the scaling of Fermi Sets accompanied by the DMC assessment for interacting electrons in jellium and in a quantum dot under high magnetic fields.

AI.tldr: 本文证明Fermi Sets（一种可证明通用的费米子波函数神经网络架构）可通过能量最小化在变分蒙特卡洛框架中系统地扩展以找到相互作用基态。通过固定相位扩散蒙特卡洛进一步优化后，随着网络规模增大，变分能量系统性地降低，而DMC的能量改进单调趋于零，表明收敛到基态。在jellium和高磁场量子点体系中展示了扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经网络波函数方法在处理费米子相互作用体系时面临可扩展性和精度挑战，需要一种能够系统逼近基态且具有理论保证的架构。
AI.method: 采用Fermi Sets神经网络架构，在VMC框架中通过能量最小化优化波函数，随后施加固定相位DMC进行后处理，并通过改变网络规模观察能量收敛行为。
AI.result: 变分能量随网络规模增大系统性地降低，DMC修正量单调减小至零，表明网络波函数已收敛到真实基态。在jellium和量子点体系中验证了该方法的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: Fermi Sets架构配合VMC+DMC策略能够系统地逼近费米子相互作用体系的基态，为基于神经网络的量子多体问题求解提供了可扩展且高精度的解决方案。

title: Fluctuation-dissipation violations in mean-field non-reciprocal spin glasses
summary: We study the out-of-equilibrium dynamics of the spherical Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model with non-reciprocal asymmetric couplings. Rather than assuming stationarity, we derive the conditions under which the dynamical mean-field equations admit stable time-translational invariant solutions. We analytically solve the asymptotics of the correlation and response functions in the symmetric, uncorrelated and antisymmetric limits, showing that the fluctuation-dissipation theorem is generically violated in the presence of non-reciprocity despite exponential relaxation, due to broken detailed balance rather than aging. Numerical results for generic asymmetry allow us to interpolate between these solvable limit cases, revealing faster dynamics as the asymmetry increases, together with oscillatory dynamics driven by antisymmetric couplings. These results provide a reference framework for understanding the dynamics of disordered, non-reciprocal systems, disentangling two distinct origins of fluctuation-dissipation violations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有非互易不对称耦合的球形Sherrington-Kirkpatrick模型的非平衡动力学，推导了动力学平均场方程存在稳定时间平移不变解的条件，并解析求解了对关联和响应函数的渐近行为，发现非互易性即使在指数弛豫下也会破坏涨落-耗散定理。
AI.motivation: 理解无序、非互易系统的非平衡动力学，特别是区分由老化（aging）和由细致平衡破坏（broken detailed balance）导致的涨落-耗散定理违反的两种不同机制。
AI.method: 在球形Sherrington-Kirkpatrick模型中引入非互易不对称耦合，推导动力学平均场方程并分析稳定时间平移不变解的存在条件；解析求解对称、不相关和反对称极限下的关联与响应函数渐近行为；通过数值模拟插值一般非对称情况。
AI.result: 涨落-耗散定理在非互易系统中普遍被违反，但原因是细致平衡破坏而非老化；不对称性增加导致动力学更快；反对称耦合引发振荡动力学。
AI.conclusion: 为非互易无序系统的动力学提供了参考框架，清晰区分了涨落-耗散定理违反的两种不同起源。

title: Imaging the Néel Vector in Two-Dimensional Antiferromagnets using Antisymmetric Compton Scattering
summary: We demonstrate that antisymmetric Compton scattering can detect both the switching and the continuous rotation of the Néel vector in two-dimensional (2D) antiferromagnets. By probing magnetoelectric (ME) multipoles, which couple electric and magnetic dipoles, this approach overcomes the limitations of conventional techniques that rely on a finite net magnetization. Using a group-theoretical decomposition of the staggered moments in 2D MnPS$_3$ into irreducible representations, combined with first-principles calculations, we show that the antisymmetric Compton profile (ACP) is highly sensitive to the Néel vector orientation: it reverses sign under Néel vector reversal and exhibits distinct anisotropies under in-plane rotation. These results establish the ACP as a versatile probe of antiferromagnetic (AFM) order and magnetoelectric phenomena in van der Waals materials.

AI.tldr: 本文证明反对称康普顿散射能够探测二维反铁磁体中Néel矢量的开关切换和连续旋转，通过探测磁电多极子克服了传统方法依赖有限净磁化强度的局限。基于MnPS₃的第一性原理计算和群论分析，表明反对称康普顿轮廓对Néel矢量方向高度敏感，可作为范德瓦尔斯材料中反铁磁序和磁电现象的多功能探针。
AI.motivation: 传统探测反铁磁序的方法依赖于有限净磁化强度，而反铁磁材料本身净磁化强度为零，因此需要发展新的探测手段。本文旨在利用反对称康普顿散射探测磁电多极子，克服这一局限。
AI.method: 结合群论将二维MnPS₃中的交错磁矩分解为不可约表示，并通过第一性原理计算，分析反对称康普顿轮廓对Néel矢量方向的响应特性。
AI.result: 反对称康普顿轮廓在Néel矢量反转时符号翻转，且在面内旋转时表现出各向异性，对Néel矢量的开关和连续旋转均具有高灵敏度。
AI.conclusion: 反对称康普顿散射可作为探测范德瓦尔斯反铁磁材料中磁序和磁电现象的多功能、高灵敏度探针。

title: Non-monotonic diffusion from nonequilibrium driving
summary: The stochastic dynamics of interacting particles far from equilibrium remains a fundamental challenge in statistical physics. While reciprocal interactions often permit effective one-body descriptions, such reductions generally fail for nonreciprocal interactions, which are ubiquitous in driven and active systems. We develop a unified theoretical framework for interacting particles with reciprocal and nonreciprocal couplings, applicable to the principal classes of active matter, including run-and-tumble, active Brownian, and active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particles. As a minimal example, we study a passive particle driven by an active particle. On a periodic ring, we show analytically that the driven particle is always diffusive at long times, independent of the microscopic driving mechanism. Analytical predictions and numerical simulations reveal a nonmonotonic dependence of the effective diffusivity on the driving activity, giving rise to both enhanced and suppressed transport. Remarkably, the same behavior occurs in an equilibrium system driven out of equilibrium by coupling the driving particle to a higher local temperature. Our framework quantitatively captures both systems, identifies the common mechanism underlying the nonmonotonic transport, and establishes a unified description of transport under active and passive nonequilibrium driving.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了包含互逆与非互逆相互作用的活性粒子统一理论框架，揭示了被动粒子在活性驱动下扩散行为随活性非单调变化的现象，并证明该行为在活性与非平衡热驱动系统中具有统一机制。
AI.motivation: 非互逆相互作用在驱动和活性系统中普遍存在，但传统方法往往需要逐个系统分析，缺乏统一的理论描述。作者希望建立一个普适框架，统一描述不同类型活性物质（如run-and-tumble、active Brownian、active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck粒子）中的输运行为。
AI.method: 发展了一个适用于互逆和非互逆耦合的统一理论框架。以周期性环上的被动粒子-活性粒子驱动系统为最小模型，通过解析推导和数值模拟相结合，并对比了活性驱动与非平衡热驱动（高温浴）两种体系。
AI.result: 1) 被动粒子在长时间下始终表现为扩散行为，与微观驱动机制无关；2) 有效扩散系数随驱动活性呈非单调变化（先增强后抑制）；3) 该非单调行为在活性驱动和局域高温驱动的平衡体系中定量一致。
AI.conclusion: 建立了活性与非平衡被动驱动下输运的统一描述，揭示了非单调输运的普遍机制，为理解远离平衡的随机动力学提供了新视角。

title: Relative hybridization textures as local coordinates for band geometry and topology
summary: Global diagnostics such as Berry curvature and quantum metrics characterize the geometry and topology of an occupied Bloch subspace, leaving the microscopic sectors that carry this structure implicit. We introduce the relative hybridization coordinate $Z$ as a projector-level diagnostic connecting these global quantities to local degrees of freedom. As the Grassmann graph coordinate relative to a chosen sector, $Z$ reconstructs the local projector and retains the phase and matrix orientation absent from ordinary weight or fat-band descriptions. On valid chart patches, its momentum-space texture encodes Berry curvature, quantum metric, Berry phases, and Wilson loops, while chart obstructions appear as rank-drop defects whose balanced-chart winding of $\det Z$ gives the first Chern number. In the QWZ model this defect inventory reproduces the Chern phase diagram. In the lattice BHZ model, matrix $Z$ diagnoses the orbital $E|H$ partition as a robust matched chart for the QSH geometry, while the spin partition remains essential to the block and $\mathbb Z_2$ interpretation and shows rank deficiency as a matched chart in the spin-conserving limit. The relative hybridization coordinate thus provides a sector-resolved framework for relating band geometry and topology to microscopic structure.

AI.tldr: 本文引入相对杂化坐标 $Z$ 作为连接全局带几何/拓扑性质与微观局域自由度的诊断工具，通过重建局域投影子并保留相位与矩阵取向，在动量空间中编码Berry曲率、量子度量等全局量，其秩亏缺陷的缠绕数给出陈数，并在QWZ和BHZ模型中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的全局诊断（如Berry曲率、量子度量）能刻画占据Bloch子空间的几何与拓扑，但隐去了承载这些结构的微观局域扇区信息，缺乏连接全局量与局域自由度的桥梁。
AI.method: 引入相对杂化坐标 $Z$ 作为Grassmann图坐标，重建局域投影子并保留相位与矩阵取向；通过其动量空间纹理编码Berry曲率、量子度量等；利用秩亏缺陷的$\det Z$缠绕数给出第一陈数。
AI.result: 在QWZ模型中缺陷清单重现了Chern相图；在BHZ模型中，矩阵$Z$诊断轨道$E|H$划分作为QSH几何的鲁棒匹配图，而自旋划分在自旋守恒极限下表现出秩亏。
AI.conclusion: 相对杂化坐标提供了一个扇区分辨的框架，用于将能带几何与拓扑关联到微观结构。

title: Ferroelectricity and antiferroelectricity in the BaS-PbS system with the rocksalt structure
comment: The accepted manuscript distributed under the CC-BY-NC-ND license. 10 pages, 6 tables, 6 figures
summary: The ferroelectric instability in superstructures, superlattices, quantum wires, and disordered solid solutions in the BaS--PbS system with the NaCl structure has been discovered and investigated using first-principles calculations within the density functional theory. The emergence of ferroelectricity in these structures is associated with the instability of TO phonons in linear --Pb--S--Pb--S-- chains, which arises as a result of stretching of the structures upon the introduction of large barium atoms. Additionally, it has been discovered that, alongside ferroelectric phases, the structures also exhibit stable, competing antiferroelectric phases and those with a mixed ferroelectric--antiferroelectric ordering (ferroelectrically polarized one-dimensional Pb--S chains arranged in an ordered or disordered manner in the perpendicular direction). These phases often become the ground state of the studied systems. The closeness of the energies of the ferroelectric, antiferroelectric, and mixed states indicates the emergence of a multi-minimum potential with an infinite number of wells separated by potential barriers in the configuration space. This suggests a possible emergence of nonergodicity in the structures at low temperatures.

AI.tldr: 基于第一性原理计算，在BaS-PbS体系中发现铁电不稳定性源于大Ba原子引入引发的结构拉伸导致Pb-S链中TO声子失稳；同时发现稳定的反铁电相和铁电-反铁电混合相，多极小势能暗示低温下可能出现非遍历性。
AI.motivation: 探索NaCl结构的BaS-PbS体系中超结构、超晶格、量子线和无序固溶体的铁电不稳定性，揭示其微观机制。
AI.method: 基于密度泛函理论的第一性原理计算。
AI.result: 发现了铁电、反铁电以及铁电-反铁电混合有序相，这些相能量接近，形成多极小势能景观。
AI.conclusion: BaS-PbS体系中铁电性源于Ba原子引入导致的Pb-S链拉伸和TO声子失稳；多相能量竞争表明系统在低温下可能出现非遍历性行为。

title: Superfluidity without charge order in the attractive Hubbard model on the kagome lattice
summary: Using auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we study the zero-temperature attractive Hubbard model on the kagome lattice at various relevant electronic fillings. The low-energy physics at $2/3$-density is influenced by the Dirac point at the Fermi energy, wherein we unveil a superfluid transition at a critical attractive interaction $U_c/t=-4.58(3)$, which belongs to the chiral-XY universality class. This U(1) symmetry-breaking is not accompanied by charge order, even for substantially large interaction strengths, in a regime where a description in terms of hardcore bosons becomes increasingly suitable. An investigation of the latter shows that charge ordering at $1/3$-filling only occurs at interaction strengths much larger than those corresponding to the mapping to the original fermionic model. Additionally, for densities exhibiting van Hove singularities in the non-interacting density of states, our results show that any attractive interaction gives rise to superfluidity, yet again without charge ordering, contrary to recent studies employing mean-field theory.

AI.tldr: 本文利用辅助场量子蒙特卡洛模拟研究了kagome晶格上吸引型Hubbard模型，发现2/3填充时存在手征-XY普适类的超流相变，且无电荷序；1/3填充时电荷序仅在远超费米子映射对应强度的相互作用下出现；在van Hove奇点密度处，任何吸引相互作用都会导致超流性，但同样无电荷序，这与平均场理论结果相反。
AI.motivation: 探究kagome晶格上吸引型Hubbard模型在不同电子填充下的低温物理行为，特别是超流性和电荷序之间的竞争关系，以及平均场理论预言的准确性。
AI.method: 使用辅助场量子蒙特卡洛（auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo）模拟方法，研究零温下kagome晶格上吸引型Hubbard模型在不同电子填充下的物理性质。
AI.result: 在2/3填充下发现超流相变临界吸引相互作用U_c/t=-4.58(3)，属于手征-XY普适类；1/3填充下电荷序仅在远超费米子模型映射强度的相互作用下出现；van Hove奇点填充下任何吸引相互作用均导致超流性但无电荷序。
AI.conclusion: Kagome晶格上吸引型Hubbard模型的超流相变表现出丰富行为，且平均场理论高估了电荷序的稳定性，量子涨落效应在其中起关键作用。

title: Interacting hydrodynamic modes in spinless fermions with dephasing noise
summary: We study the non-equilibrium dynamics of spinless fermions with dephasing noise in the framework of a many-particle Lindblad equation. Using a mapping to the exactly solvable one-dimensional Hubbard model with purely imaginary tunneling amplitude we analyze the Heisenberg-picture dynamics of operators quartic in fermions and determine their hydrodynamic projections. We construct the relevant diffusive eigenoperators explicitly and show that, in the quartic sector, they can be interpreted as interacting pairs of bilinear hydrodynamic modes. As a consequence, translationally invariant quartic operators generically exhibit non-vanishing diffusive late-time tails, unlike translationally invariant bilinears. Our results show that the hydrodynamic tails of microscopic operators cannot in general be inferred from symmetry constraints or coarse-grained fluctuating hydrodynamics alone; they also depend crucially on the spatial structure and effective size of the hydrodynamic eigenoperators.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了带退相噪的自旋less费米子的非平衡动力学，通过映射到虚隧穿的一维Hubbard模型，发现四次费米子算符存在非零的扩散尾，而双线性算符则没有，揭示了流体力学尾不仅取决于对称性，还依赖于算符的空间结构和有效尺寸。
AI.motivation: 理解开放量子系统中多体算符的长时间流体力学行为，特别是探讨不同阶次（双线性 vs. 四次）算符的扩散尾是否存在差异，以及如何超越粗粒化流体力学理论的预测。
AI.method: 将带退相噪的自旋less费米子的Lindblad方程映射到虚隧穿的一维Hubbard模型；利用该模型的可解性，在海森堡绘景中分析四次费米子算符的动力学，构造扩散本征算符并计算其流体力学投影。
AI.result: 四次费米子算符可被解释为双线性流体力学模式的相互作用对，且平移不变的四次算符普遍存在非零扩散尾，而平移不变的双线性算符则没有。
AI.conclusion: 流体力学尾不能仅从对称性或粗粒化流体力学推断，还取决于算符的空间结构和有效尺寸；高阶算符的长时间行为比之前认为的更丰富。

title: Transformer Atomic Cluster Expansion: TRACE
summary: Designing machine-learning interatomic potentials involves achieving the precise representation of complex many-body interactions alongside the efficiency required for scalable molecular dynamics. We introduce Transformer Atomic Cluster Expansion (TRACE), an energy-conserving architecture that combines atomic cluster expansion density correlations with local multihead cross-attention. The correlations form an O(3)-equivariant state for each center, which queries tensorial neighbor features that remain fixed functions of species and geometry. No learned state is passed between atoms. On a laptop MacBook-M1, we train and test TRACE for polymorphic cesium lead iodide, liquid water, and intramolecular methyl migration against experiments. For cesium lead iodide, TRACE reproduces the r$^2$SCAN+rVV10 ordering of four polymorphs and gives a classical edge-sharing hexagonal non-perovskite($δ$) to corner-sharing cubic perovskite($α$) Gibbs-free-energy crossing $\simeq$580K near the experimental observations of $\simeq$600K. By employing enhanced sampling to cross high energy barriers, the same TRACE potential successfully captures the $δ$-to-$α$ perovskite transformation without any reinforcement learning. A water potential trained on a reduced set of CCSD(T) configurations places the first oxygen--oxygen maximum at 2.85~Å, compared to the experimental value of 2.80~Å. For the gas-phase methyl migration in 2,2-dimethylisoindene, umbrella sampling yields an activation free energy of $27.92\pm0.03$~kcal~mol$^{-1}$, in close agreement with the experimental measurement of $29.2\pm1.1$~kcal~mol$^{-1}$. Across these diverse benchmarks, a single unified architecture successfully captures multi-species crystallization, liquid structures, phase diagrams, and chemical reactivity.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一种结合原子簇展开密度相关性与局部多头交叉注意力的能量守恒架构，在笔记本电脑上即可高效训练，并在钙钛矿相变、水结构、化学反应等多个领域达到与实验高度吻合的精度。
AI.motivation: 当前机器学习原子间势需要在精确表示复杂多体相互作用与可扩展分子动力学效率之间取得平衡，现有方法在这两方面仍有改进空间。
AI.method: 提出Transformer Atomic Cluster Expansion (TRACE)架构，将原子簇展开(ACE)的密度相关性与局部多头交叉注意力机制结合，构建O(3)等变状态用于查询张量化的邻居特征，原子间不传递学习状态。
AI.result: 在MacBook-M1上训练，CsPbI₃的δ→α相变自由能交叉点~580K（实验~600K）；水的O-O第一峰2.85Å（实验2.80Å）；甲基迁移活化自由能27.92±0.03 kcal/mol（实验29.2±1.1 kcal/mol）。
AI.conclusion: 单一统一架构TRACE能成功捕捉多物种结晶、液体结构、相图和化学反应活性，展现了跨领域的通用性与高精度。

title: Solvable Quantum Circuits with non-Markovian Influence Matrices
summary: Influence matrices encode the action exerted on local subsystems by the rest of an extended quantum many-body system during their evolution. Thus, knowledge of the influence matrix facilitates computationally efficient simulations of local dynamics. Here we propose a new systematic approach to generating quantum circuits with complex dynamics for which the influence matrices can be written down exactly. In contrast to previous frameworks of this kind, such as dual-unitary circuits, the resulting influence matrices are non-Markovian, exhibiting nontrivial temporal correlations. We explicitly construct a broad family of circuits of this kind, based on dressing free-fermion (matchgate) circuits with appropriately chosen interaction terms. We show that, contrary to previous solvable instances, these circuits produce patterns of correlations that closely resemble that of typical many-body systems. Our approach can be directly interpreted in terms of an error correction scheme where the terms breaking the solvability of the influence matrices play the role of errors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新方法，通过修饰自由费米子（matchgate）电路并添加特定相互作用项，生成具有复杂动力学但影响矩阵可精确求解的量子电路。与传统双酉电路不同，该电路的影响矩阵具有非马尔可夫性，且关联模式更接近典型多体系统。该方法还可从纠错码角度理解，其中破坏可解性的项被视为错误。
AI.motivation: 现有可解量子电路模型（如双酉电路）产生的影响矩阵通常具有马尔可夫性（无时间关联），无法捕捉典型多体系统中的复杂时间关联模式。作者希望构建一类新型可解电路，其影响矩阵存在非平凡的时间关联，从而更真实地模拟典型多体系统的动力学行为。
AI.method: 以自由费米子（matchgate）电路为基础，通过"修饰"（dressing）方式有选择地添加特定相互作用项。这些修饰项被精心设计，使得整体电路的影响矩阵仍然可以精确写出，但呈现出非马尔可夫性（即存在时间上的长程关联）。
AI.result: 成功构建了一族新型可解量子电路，其影响矩阵具有非马尔可夫性；这些电路产生的关联模式与典型多体系统高度相似，优于以往可解模型（如双酉电路）。此外，揭示了该方法与纠错码之间的内在联系。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种系统性的可解量子电路构造方法，克服了前人模型无法产生时间关联的局限，为高效模拟局部动力学提供了新工具。同时，从纠错角度理解模型可解性，可能为量子纠错和量子模拟领域带来启发。

title: Quantum metric quadrupoles in elemental bismuth thin films
summary: The nonlinear transport properties of solids are deeply rooted in the quantum geometry of their electronic wavefunctions, which is encoded in the quantum geometric tensor. Its real part, known as the quantum metric, has been recently identified as a primary origin of nonlinear transport in quantum materials where time-reversal and inversion symmetries are not simultaneously present. Consequently, the influence of the quantum metric on the largest class of materials -- non-magnetic and centrosymmetric systems -- has remained entirely elusive. Here, we demonstrate that third-order transport in centrosymmetric materials hosting relativistic fermions is governed by quantum metric quadrupoles (QMQs). We show that these QMQs can originate from both the non-Abelian quantum geometry of bulk three-dimensional Dirac fermions and the Abelian quantum geometry of spin-orbit-coupled surface states. In stark contrast to all zero-field nonlinear transport signatures known to date, the current driven by these QMQs persists as a robust, non-vanishing observable even in highly scalable polycrystalline thin films. We experimentally validate this quantum metric footprint by measuring nonlinear transport in thin films of elemental bismuth, observing a robust, surface-dominated, and broadband third-harmonic generation that persists up to room temperature. Our findings uncover a hidden role of the quantum metric in polycrystalline systems, establishing third-order nonlinear transport as a high-precision diagnostic tool of wavefunction geometry under ambient conditions.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现非磁性中心对称材料中的三阶非线性输运由量子度量四极子（QMQs）主导，并在多晶铋薄膜中实验验证了这种鲁棒的、表面主导的、宽带的三次谐波产生，确立了量子度量在可规模化多晶体系中的作用。
AI.motivation: 量子度量已被发现是破坏时间反演或反演对称性材料中非线性输运的起源，但对于最大类的非磁性中心对称材料，其影响一直未知。作者希望填补这一空白，探索中心对称体系中量子度量对非线性输运的调控机制。
AI.method: 理论推导了中心对称材料中三阶输运由量子度量四极子（QMQs）主导的机制，考虑了非阿贝尔体狄拉克费米子和阿贝尔表面自旋轨道耦合态的贡献；实验上在多晶铋薄膜中测量非线性输运，观测三次谐波产生。

title: Laser induced optical reconfiguration in Ge_Sb_Te Films with composition dependent response
summary: Phase change Ge_Sb_Te (GST) materials exhibit pronounced optical contrast and tunability driven by structural transformations, enabling a diverse range of photonic and optoelectronic applications. GST materials undergo reversible amorphous crystalline phase transitions during which the refractive index and extinction coefficient increase significantly in the crystalline phase across a broad spectral range. However, a systematic correlation between local composition, crystalline microstructure, and broadband optical response within as deposited crystalline GST films has not been established, particularly for films spanning various compositions within a single growth process and in the absence of amorphous-crystalline transitions. Here, we report a systematic study of composition resolved optostructural property relationships in as-deposited crystalline GST films spanning Ge3Sb2Te6, Ge2Sb2Te5, and GeSb2Te4 within a single CVD process, avoiding intermediate phase transitions. This enables direct correlations between composition, microstructure, morphology, and broadband optical response across 400-1700 nm. Specifically, the compositional gradient results in a shift of the absorption minimum from 815.9 nm to 889.8 nm, accompanied by a 5.9 fold change in the intensity, reflecting the strong dependence of optical behavior on composition and microstructure. We further show that femtosecond laser irradiation enables spatially selective tuning of the optical response. These findings establish crystalline GST films as a platform for broadband-tunable, spatially programmable photonic elements, controllable through both compositional design and localized laser processing.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了单次CVD工艺中沉积的Ge₃Sb₂Te₆、Ge₂Sb₂Te₅和GeSb₂Te₄三种晶态GST薄膜的成分、微结构与宽谱（400-1700 nm）光学性能之间的关系，发现成分梯度导致吸收最小值从815.9 nm移至889.8 nm，强度变化达5.9倍，并展示了飞秒激光可实现空间选择性光学调控。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对沉积态晶态GST薄膜中局部成分、微结构与宽谱光学响应之间系统关联的认知，尤其是单一生长过程中不同成分薄膜的对比研究尚属空白。
AI.method: 通过单次CVD工艺制备成分梯度变化的晶态GST薄膜（Ge₃Sb₂Te₆、Ge₂Sb₂Te₅、GeSb₂Te₄），避免非晶-晶相变过程，直接关联成分、微结构、形貌与400-1700 nm宽谱光学响应，并采用飞秒激光辐照实现空间选择性调控。
AI.result: 成分梯度使吸收最小值从815.9 nm移至889.8 nm，强度变化达5.9倍，光学行为对成分和微结构有强烈依赖性；飞秒激光可实现空间选择性光学调控。
AI.conclusion: 晶态GST薄膜可作为宽带可调、空间可编程的光子元件平台，通过成分设计和局部激光加工实现灵活调控。

title: Quantum oscillation spectroscopy of Fermi-surface topologies in tetralayer graphene
summary: Quantum oscillations offer a direct probe of Fermi-surface topology and electronic degeneracy, yet disentangling both simultaneously across the Lifshitz transitions of multiband systems has remained an open experimental challenge. Here, we use Shubnikov-de Haas spectroscopy on a high-mobility, dual-gated Bernal-stacked tetralayer graphene (B-4LG) device to quantitatively reconstruct the complete sequence of six distinct Fermi-surface topologies-gully, annular, singly connected, and multiband pockets. The extracted oscillation frequencies determine the extremal momentum-space areas and their spin, valley, and gully-resolved degeneracies, in quantitative agreement with our tight-binding calculations. We further show that a perpendicular magnetic-field, combined with displacement-field lifts the valley degeneracy through an orbital-Zeeman coupling, producing a single-particle valley splitting of several $meV$, far larger than in bilayer or trilayer graphene. Our work demonstrates a framework for tracking Fermi-surface topologies and their flavor degeneracies in multiband quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Shubnikov-de Haas光谱学在Bernal堆叠四层石墨烯中定量重构了六种不同的费米面拓扑结构（沟道型、环形、单连通型及多带口袋），并揭示了通过轨道-塞曼耦合实现的谷简并分裂，为多带量子材料中费米面拓扑与简并度的追踪提供了通用框架。
AI.motivation: 尽管量子振荡是探测费米面拓扑和电子简并度的直接手段，但在多带体系的Lifshitz相变中同时解析两者一直是一个未解决的实验挑战。本文旨在解决这一难题。
AI.method: 采用高迁移率、双栅极Bernal堆叠四层石墨烯器件，利用Shubnikov-de Haas光谱学进行测量。通过提取振荡频率确定极值动量空间面积及其自旋、谷、沟道分辨的简并度，并与紧束缚模型计算定量比对。此外，通过垂直磁场与位移场结合，利用轨道-塞曼耦合实现谷简并分裂。
AI.result: 成功定量重构了六种不同的费米面拓扑结构。观测到轨道-塞曼耦合导致的谷简并分裂可达数个meV，远大于双层或三层石墨烯中的分裂值。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了在多带量子材料中追踪费米面拓扑及其味道简并度的实验框架，为理解复杂量子材料的电子结构提供了新途径。

title: Integrating moment tensor potentials with finite-element modeling for heat transfer prediction in FLiBe-based molten salt systems
summary: Molten fluoride salts are promising heat-transfer media for advanced molten salt reactors (MSRs), where reliable thermophysical property determination is critical for component design and safety. We present an integrated multiscale framework that couples machine-learning-driven atomistic simulations with finite-element (FE) modeling to predict the heat-transfer performance of FLiBe-based salts in a linear heat exchanger. At the atomistic scale, Moment Tensor Potentials (MTPs), actively trained on ab initio data, are developed for pure FLiBe (66-34 and 74-26 LiF-BeF2 mol%), FLiBe-LaF3, and FLiBe-UF4. These potentials are used in molecular dynamics simulations to obtain temperature- and composition-dependent transport properties (density, viscosity, thermal conductivity, and isobaric heat capacity), which are mapped as inputs to a three-dimensional FE model of the experimental thermal loop. The FE model with literature transport properties reproduces the experimental heat-transfer behavior of pure FLiBe to within 10% in the laminar regime and 18% in the transitional and turbulent regimes, validating the end-to-end pipeline for this composition. The same model with MTP-MD-derived transport properties systematically overestimates the heat-transfer coefficient by 25-28%, an offset consistent with the MTP-MD biases on thermal conductivity and viscosity. Applied to the ternary systems FLiBe-LaF3 and FLiBe-UF4 over 0-5 mol%, the MTP-MD-driven FE model predicts a mean reduction in heat-transfer efficiency of 8-11% relative to pure FLiBe, with UF4 exhibiting the strongest effect. The qualitative ordering of the three systems is the more robust result; the absolute value of the 8-11% figure is contingent on the MTP accuracy. The framework is complementary to high-temperature experiments and provides a physics-based pathway for the rapid screening of MSR coolant formulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个集成多尺度框架，结合机器学习驱动的原子模拟（MTP-MD）与有限元（FE）建模，用于预测FLiBe基熔盐在热交换器中的传热性能。通过MTP-MD获得温度和组分依赖的传输性质，输入FE模型预测传热系数。纯FLiBe验证中，FE模型重现实验误差在10-18%内；MTP-MD驱动的模型高估25-28%，但三元体系（添加LaF₃或UF₄）预测传热效率降低8-11%的相对趋势稳健。
AI.motivation: 熔融氟盐是先进熔盐反应堆（MSR）中极具前景的传热介质，但其热物理性质的可靠测定对组件设计和安全性至关重要。传统高温实验成本高、周期长，亟需一种高效的物理驱动预测方法。
AI.method: (1) 在原子尺度开发Moment Tensor Potentials（MTPs），基于主动学习从第一性原理数据训练； (2) 用MTP进行分子动力学（MD）模拟获取密度、粘度、导热系数和等压热容等传输性质； (3) 将这些性质作为输入映射到三维有限元（FE）模型中，模拟线性热交换器的传热性能。
AI.result: (1) 纯FLiBe：FE模型（文献性质）复现实验误差层流区≤10%、过渡和湍流区≤18%； (2) MTP-MD驱动的模型系统高估传热系数25-28%，偏差源于MTP对导热系数和粘度的偏差； (3) 三元体系（0-5 mol% LaF₃或UF₄）：预测传热效率降低8-11%，UF₄影响最强，且三种体系的定性排序稳健。
AI.conclusion: 该多尺度框架是高温实验的补充，提供了一条基于物理的路径，可快速筛选MSR冷却剂配方。尽管MTP的绝对精度仍有提升空间，但定性趋势预测具有可靠性。

title: Programmable Bulk Topological Channels via Strain Engineering
summary: Accumulated disorder at physical boundaries prevents the realization of ideal zero-dissipation topological edge channels. Here, we propose a strain engineering mechanism to create a topological domain wall in the pristine material bulk, thereby generating interior chiral channels spatially decoupled from physical boundaries. Quantum transport simulations reveal that these interior channels exhibit exceptional immunity to severe boundary disorder, maintaining an ideal vortex-free transport morphology. Furthermore, the spatial position and confinement of these interior channels can be quantitatively programmed. Under a linear gradient strain field, the channel width obeys an inverse square-root scaling law with respect to the strain gradient. In a high-Chern-number phase (|C|=2), we design the spatial splitting and merging of co-propagating chiral channels, suggesting a topological Mach-Zehnder-like geometry. These results suggest a route toward programmable bulk topological transport and reconfigurable topological circuitry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用应变工程在纯净材料内部创建拓扑畴壁，从而生成与物理边界解耦的内部手征通道。这些通道对边界无序具有优异免疫力，且其空间位置和宽度可通过应变梯度定量调控，在高陈数相中还可实现通道的分裂与合并，为可编程拓扑输运和可重构拓扑电路提供了新路径。
AI.motivation: 物理边界处的累积无序会破坏理想零耗散拓扑边缘态，作者希望通过在材料内部而非边界构建拓扑通道，从根本上规避边界无序问题。
AI.method: 提出应变工程机制，在纯净材料内部创建拓扑畴壁；通过量子输运模拟验证内部手征通道的特性；利用线性梯度应变场定量调控通道宽度和位置。
AI.result: 内部通道对严重边界无序具有优异免疫力，保持理想的无涡旋输运形态；通道宽度与应变梯度服从反平方根标度律；在高陈数相(|C|=2)中实现了共传播手征通道的空间分裂与合并。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为可编程体拓扑输运和可重构拓扑电路提供了可行路线，开辟了在材料内部而非边界实现拓扑保护输运的新范式。

title: Element-Specific Visualization of Layer-Parity and Twist-Dependent Magnetism in CrSBr
summary: Van der Waals (vdW) based antiferromagnets (AFMs) are an ideal platform for probing and understanding thickness- and twist-angle-dependent emergent spin phenomena. However, element-specific nanoscale characterization of the spin structure in atomically thin vdW-based AFMs systems and layer-parity effects remain elusive, making them crucial for both fundamental insight into low-dimensional magnetism and the rational design of spintronic devices based on these materials. Here, we utilize X-ray magnetic circular and linear dichroisms paired with photoemission electron microscopy to resolve the magnetic order in atomically thin CrSBr. Our comprehensive measurements reveal CrSBr magnetic structure at the nanoscale and its dependence on the layer number, surface encapsulation, temperature, and applied field. Moreover, in the orthogonally twisted bilayer configuration, obtained by twisting two CrSBr ferromagnetic monolayers by 90$^\circ$, the magnetic easy axis fundamentally differs from the individual monolayers, unlocking a new pathway for moiré magnetism.

AI.tldr: 本文利用X射线磁圆二色性和磁线二色性结合光电子发射电子显微镜，揭示了原子级薄层CrSBr中纳米尺度的磁结构及其对层数、表面封装、温度和磁场的依赖关系，并在正交扭转双层中发现了全新的磁各向异性行为，为莫尔磁学研究开辟了新路径。
AI.motivation: 尽管范德华反铁磁体是研究低维自旋现象的理想平台，但原子级薄层体系中自旋结构的元素特异性纳米尺度表征以及层奇偶效应仍未被揭示，这对理解低维磁性和设计自旋电子器件至关重要。
AI.method: 利用X射线磁圆二色性（XMCD）和X射线磁线二色性（XMLD）结合光电子发射电子显微镜（PEEM），对原子级薄层CrSBr的磁序进行表征。
AI.result: 成功实现了CrSBr在纳米尺度的磁结构成像，揭示了其磁序对层数、表面封装、温度和磁场的依赖关系；在正交扭转（90°）双层CrSBr中，发现了与单层截然不同的磁易轴方向。
AI.conclusion: 该研究不仅填补了原子级薄层vdW反铁磁体纳米尺度自旋结构表征的空白，还通过扭转工程实现了磁各向异性的调控，为基于莫尔磁学的新型自旋电子器件设计提供了新思路。

title: Stacking Polarity-Controlled Interlayer Photocarrier Dynamics in MoSe2/MoS2 Heterostructures
summary: Control of interlayer photocarrier dynamics is central to optoelectronic applications of van der Waals heterostructures, yet deterministic and spatially uniform tuning strategies remain limited. Here we show that stacking polarity provides a global control parameter for photocarrier dynamics in MoSe$_2$/MoS$_2$ heterostructures. By comparing hexagonal (2H) and rhombohedral (3R) MoS$_2$ bilayers and engineering opposite interface terminations in 3R stacking, we resolve stacking-dependent interlayer charge-transfer dynamics using ultrafast pump--probe spectroscopy. While charge transfer in the 2H heterostructure occurs faster than the experimental resolution, the 3R heterostructures show time-resolvable charge transfer that slows from $0.25$ to $0.37$~ps depending on stacking polarity. Furthermore, the interlayer exciton lifetime is tuned from $\sim$$40$ to $\sim$$170$~ps. These effects arise from stacking-induced layer polarization in 3R MoS$_2$, which modulates interfacial wavefunction overlap.

AI.tldr: 本文发现MoSe₂/MoS₂异质结中的堆叠极性（2H vs 3R）可作为全局控制参数，有效调控层间光生载流子动力学，其中3R堆叠的电荷转移时间可从0.25 ps调至0.37 ps，层间激子寿命从~40 ps调至~170 ps。
AI.motivation: 层间光生载流子动力学对范德华异质结的光电应用至关重要，但目前缺乏确定性强且空间均匀的调控策略。
AI.method: 对比2H和3R MoS₂双层，通过设计3R堆叠中相反的界面终止结构，利用超快泵浦-探测光谱解析堆叠依赖的层间电荷转移动力学。
AI.result: 2H异质结的电荷转移快于实验分辨率，而3R异质结中电荷转移可时间分辨，速度从0.25 ps降至0.37 ps；层间激子寿命从~40 ps调至~170 ps。
AI.conclusion: 这些效应源于3R MoS₂中堆叠诱导的层极化，从而调控了界面波函数重叠。

title: Predicting the Slow Drift of Nuclear Spin Noise in Semiconductor Spin Qubits
summary: The dynamics of a nuclear spin bath generates magnetic noise that is a key contributor to the decoherence of electron spin qubits in electrostatically-defined quantum dots. In this paper, we extend the cluster correlation expansion (CCE) technique, which has proven useful for predicting solid-state qubit coherence times across various settings but is limited to shorter time scales, to incorporate stochastic treatments of cluster dynamics in order to efficiently predict slow drifting Overhauser fields over longer time scales. This approach combines quantum evolution with classical rate matrices to enable simulation across a wide range of temporal regimes required to simulate, for example, the long-time convergence of the ergodic $T_2^*$ from Ramsey experiments. Our methodology is validated against experimental data from various silicon spin qubit systems, demonstrating a strong agreement between simulation and measurement of Ramsey experiments presented in the form of $T_2^*$ versus averaging time, autocorrelation functions, as well as power spectral densities. Furthermore, we demonstrate significant back-action effects through modeling and experiment; specifically, the dynamics of the nuclear spin bath depends upon the electron spin occupation schedule. Finally, our modeling quantitatively predicts the benefits from compensating for the slow drift of Overhauser fields in qubit operations. Our findings indicate that compensating for an Overhauser rotation measured $Δt$ in the past results in an effective $T_2^*$, which we denote $\tilde{T}_2^*(Δt)$ for clarity, under certain scenarios of interest, can be one or two orders of magnitude larger than the ergodic $T_2^*$ if the Overhauser rotation is re-characterized every 100 milliseconds; that is, $\tilde{T}_2^*(Δt = 100~{\rm ms})$ can be $10$ to $100$ times larger than $T_2^*$.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了团簇关联展开（CCE）技术，引入随机处理方法来模拟核自旋浴的慢速漂移Overhauser场，结合量子演化与经典速率矩阵，实现了从短时到长时多种时间尺度的仿真，并在硅自旋量子比特实验中验证了该方法与实验数据的高度吻合。
AI.motivation: 核自旋浴的动力学产生的磁噪声是静电定义量子点中电子自旋量子比特退相干的关键因素。现有CCE技术虽能预测固态量子比特相干时间，但局限于较短时间内尺度，无法有效模拟长时间尺度下的缓慢漂移Overhauser场。
AI.method: 将CCE技术与随机处理方法结合，通过量子演化与经典速率矩阵的融合，实现跨时间尺度的模拟。同时引入电子自旋占用调度对核自旋浴动力学的反作用效应。
AI.result: 方法在多种硅自旋量子比特系统中验证，与Ramsey实验的T2*、自相关函数及功率谱密度等测量结果高度一致。发现补偿过去Δt时刻测量的Overhauser旋转，在每100毫秒重新表征的条件下，有效T2*可比遍历T2*大10-100倍。
AI.conclusion: 该方法准确预测了核自旋浴动力学与电子自旋的相互作用，并量化了补偿Overhauser场慢漂移对量子比特操作带来的显著性能提升。

title: Accurate Prediction of the $α\to β$ Phase Transformation Temperature in Tin via Full Anharmonic Treatment
summary: Predicting the $α\to β$ (grey-to-white) transition temperature in tin presents a longstanding challenge for atomistic simulations, with existing theoretical approaches over- or underestimating the experimental boundary (286 K) by up to several hundred Kelvin. In this work, we construct an Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) potential trained on density functional theory data to evaluate the finite-temperature free energies of both phases. Evaluated on the same potential energy surface, the quasi-harmonic approximation predicts a transformation temperature of 377 K, whereas full thermodynamic integration, which accounts for explicit vibrational anharmonicity, yields 288 K. This shift directly quantifies the explicit anharmonic free energy, which is substantial for metallic $β$-Sn but negligible for semiconducting $α$-Sn. The anisotropic anharmonicity in $β$-Sn is corroborated by its excess heat capacity, temperature-driven renormalization of its vibrational spectrum, and deviations of its atomic forces and displacements from the harmonic reference. Our results demonstrate that capturing full lattice anharmonicity is essential for predicting the phase stability of tin, while the absolute transition temperature remains limited by the accuracy of the underlying 0 K energetics.

AI.tldr: 通过原子簇展开(ACE)势能结合热力学积分，精确预测了锡的α→β相变温度为288 K，接近实验值286 K，揭示了显式非简谐振动自由能对β-Sn相稳定性的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 锡的α→β相变温度(286 K)长期以来难以通过原子模拟准确预测，现有理论方法误差高达数百开尔文，亟需发展能够精确描述有限温度自由能的计算方法。
AI.method: 构建基于密度泛函理论数据的原子簇展开(ACE)势，采用准简谐近似和完整热力学积分两种方法计算两相的有限温度自由能，通过对比定量分离出显式非简谐振动自由能。
AI.result: 准简谐近似预测相变温度为377 K，而完整热力学积分(包含显式非简谐效应)得到288 K，与实验值286 K高度吻合。显式非简谐自由能在金属性β-Sn中显著，在半导体α-Sn中可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 捕获完整的晶格非简谐性对预测锡的相稳定性至关重要；但绝对转变温度仍受限于底层0 K能量计算的精度。

title: Facet-Dependent Electronic Properties and Interfacial Point Defect Interactions in WS$_2$/ZnO Heterostructures
summary: Aiming at two-dimensional materials for high-efficiency optoelectronics, WS$2$/ZnO heterostructures are computationally screened for their facet-dependent electronic properties and interfacial defect thermodynamics using first-principles hybrid functional calculations. Interface comparison identifies the non-polar ($10\overline{1}0$) $m$-plane as the optimal substrate facet, maintaining a direct 2.42~eV bandgap and a robust type-I band alignment. Isolated sulfur ($\mathrm{V_S}$) and interfacial oxygen ($\mathrm{V_O}$) vacancies introduce deep non-radiative recombination centers. Conversely, zinc vacancies ($\mathrm{V{Zn}}$) act as shallow acceptors near the valence band edge, contributing to unintentional $p$-type behavior. Analysis of defect pairs reveals that neutral vacancies cluster across the van der Waals gap due to favorable binding energies. Under $n$-type conditions, defects stabilize as charged species. Although inter-layer Coulomb repulsion weakens the binding energy of $(\mathrm{V_S} - \mathrm{V_{Zn}})''''$ pairs, their formation energy drops to 2.61~eV under anion-poor conditions, making the $-4$ cluster the most thermodynamically abundant defect pair at the interface. Furthermore, native $\mathrm{V_{Zn}}$ prevents the Fermi level rise typically induced by interstitial hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_i}$), distributing donated electrons into shallow acceptor states and preserving host band edge rigidity. These findings establish a microscopic framework for substrate selection and defect engineering in 2D/3D hybrid light-emitting diodes.

AI.tldr: 通过第一性原理杂化泛函计算，系统筛选了WS₂/ZnO异质结构的 facets 依赖电子性质和界面缺陷热力学，发现非极性m面是最优衬底面，揭示了各类空位缺陷的能级行为及缺陷对的热力学稳定性，为2D/3D混合发光二极管的衬底选择和缺陷工程提供了微观框架。
AI.motivation: 针对二维材料用于高效光电器件的需求，需要从理论上筛选最优的衬底取向，并理解界面缺陷对器件性能的影响，从而指导实验上的缺陷工程和衬底选择。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理杂化泛函（hybrid functional）计算方法，对WS₂/ZnO异质结构进行 facet 依赖的电子性质计算，以及界面缺陷热力学分析，包括孤立缺陷和缺陷对的形成能、结合能及电荷态分析。
AI.result: 1) 非极性m面(10-10)是最优衬底面，保持2.42 eV直接带隙和I型能带对齐；2) 孤立硫空位(V_S)和界面氧空位(V_O)引入深能级非辐射复合中心，锌空位(V_Zn)为浅受主，贡献非故意p型行为；3) 中性空位易在范德华间隙处聚集成团；4) (V_S-V_Zn)''''对在贫阴离子条件下形成能降至2.61 eV，是最丰富的缺陷对；5) 本征V_Zn可抑制氢间隙(H_i)导致的费米能级上升，保持带边刚性。
AI.conclusion: 建立了WS₂/ZnO异质结构中衬底取向选择与缺陷调控的微观框架，为2D/3D混合发光二极管的优化设计提供了理论基础。

title: Singular geometry and eigenframe topology in local rank-2 tensor observables
summary: Symmetric second-rank tensors are reported through magnitude-ordered principal values and axes. This representation folds tensor space: although the physical tensor remains smooth, the reported parameters develop cusps and exchange labels when one principal value crosses zero or two become degenerate. It conceals a global effect: an arrow chosen along a principal axis and transported continuously around a closed loop encircling a degeneracy can return with opposite orientation, even though the tensor returns to itself. This reversal defines a binary return parity that is invariant under smooth loop deformations that avoid degeneracy. We use the electric-field-gradient (EFG) tensor as a clean prototype because it is symmetric, traceless, and locally measurable at a probe site. Applied strain provides external control coordinates that steer the local EFG through tensor space, as determined from first-principles calculations. In rutile TiO2, we identify an isolated control-space degeneracy with nontrivial parity; SnO2 exhibits point- or line-like degeneracies depending on the control slice; and in cubic MgO, strain locally controls all five EFG components. These results distinguish local reporting singularities from global eigenframe topology. The underlying spectral geometry also applies to spatial tensor fields, and strain-tuned, orientation-resolved hyperfine spectroscopy offers a route to reconstruct return parity locally.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了对称二阶张量在通过主值和主轴表示时存在的拓扑奇异性：当主值穿越零或出现简并时，报告参数会产生尖点并交换标签，并且沿闭合环路环绕简并点运输主轴箭头可能导致方向反转。利用电场梯度张量在应变调控下的性质，在TiO2、SnO2和MgO中验证了这些全局拓扑效应。
AI.motivation: 对称二阶张量的标准表示方式（按大小排序的主值和主轴）虽然直观，但会掩盖全局拓扑效应——当主值穿越零或出现简并时，报告参数产生非物理的奇异性，且沿简并点环绕的主轴箭头可能发生反转。作者希望揭示并区分这种局部报告奇点与全局本征框架拓扑，为实验测量提供理论基础。
AI.method: 以电场梯度（EFG）张量为原型（对称、无迹、可局域测量），通过第一性原理计算模拟应变调控下的EFG张量演化。在金红石TiO2、SnO2和立方MgO中，利用应变作为外部控制坐标，识别控制空间中的简并点及其拓扑奇偶性（return parity）。
AI.result: (1) TiO2中存在一个具有非平凡奇偶性的孤立控制空间简并点；(2) SnO2中简并表现为点状或线状，取决于控制切片的选择；(3) MgO中应变可局域调控全部五个EFG分量。这些结果区分了局部报告奇点与全局本征框架拓扑。
AI.conclusion: 不对称二阶张量的标准表示隐藏了全局拓扑效应（主轴箭头环绕简并点的反转奇偶性），而应变调控、取向分辨的超精细光谱学为实验重构这种局部返回奇偶性提供了可行途径。该结论也适用于空间张量场。

title: Extracting Atomic Environments for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
summary: In order to appropriately capture large-scale material features and emergent phenomena via atomistic simulations, such as Molecular Dynamics (MD), the system scale can range up to hundreds of millions of atoms. However, the force-field models that drive those simulations are generally trained with Density Functional Theory (DFT) reference data, limited to relatively small configurations on the order of 100s or 1000s of atoms. To compute DFT forces on atoms in regions of interest, for example for active-learning or on-the-fly training of interatomic potentials, one needs to extract a small set of atoms from the larger simulation box, and typical work with periodic boundary conditions for DFT; however, methods to select the shape and size of this extracted set of atoms, as well as to generate a potentially necessary passivating envelope, have not been systematically analyzed. In this work, we present a benchmark of various techniques to extract atomic environments from large, bulk configurations and embed them into smaller configurations suitable for DFT calculations with periodic boundary conditions. We test with a diverse set of material systems, which includes amorphous $\mathrm{SiO_2}$, Ta with screw dislocations, and molten C. We demonstrated a notably simple procedure, a method we refer to as deletions, yields superior performance over an array of alternative extraction methods.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地基准测试了从大尺度原子构型中提取子集并进行周期性DFT计算的各种方法，发现一种名为"deletions"的简单方法在多种材料体系（非晶SiO₂、含位错Ta、熔融C）中表现最优。
AI.motivation: 分子动力学模拟可处理上亿原子，但其力场通常基于DFT数据训练，而DFT仅能处理数百至数千原子。从大体系中提取相关原子子集用于DFT计算时，如何选择提取区域的形状、大小及钝化层缺乏系统性分析。
AI.method: 对多种原子环境提取方法进行基准测试，包括"deletions"（简单删除外围原子）等方法，并在非晶SiO₂、含螺位错Ta、熔融C等不同材料体系上验证，将提取的子集嵌入适合周期性边界条件的DFT计算构型中。
AI.result: "Deletions"这一简单方法在多种材料体系中均优于其他提取方法，能更好地保留目标区域的力场特征。
AI.conclusion: 简单删除外围原子的方法（deletions）在大体系原子子集提取任务中效果最佳，为主动学习和力场在线训练提供了有效工具。

title: The interplay of crystal-field transitions and exchange spin dynamics in a ferrimagnet
summary: Rare-earth iron garnets offer an ideal platform for exploring the interplay of low-energy excitations and the complex temperature-dependent magnetization dynamics. In these systems, exchange coupling between rare-earth and iron sublattices generates high-frequency collective spin excitations. In addition, the robust spin-orbit coupling of localized 4$f$ electrons triggers the crystal-electric-field (CEF) transitions at THz frequencies. Despite extensive research into the garnet spin dynamics, the interplay between CEF excitations and exchange modes has remained largely unmapped. Using temperature-dependent THz time-domain spectroscopy, we demonstrate a hybridization between the Yb-ion CEF excitation and the Yb-Fe exchange mode in Gd$_{3/2}$Yb$_{1/2}$BiFe$_{5}$O$_{12}$. This coupling is characterized by a significant redistribution of spectral and temporal weights as the material approaches its magnetization compensation temperature. Notably, the Yb-Fe exchange mode exhibits an anomalous redshift upon cooling -- a reversal of the conventional blue shift typically driven by increased exchange coupling. We trace this phenomenon to a modification of Yb-Fe exchange anisotropy, driven by the interplay of the Fe exchange field and Yb CEF excitations. These findings highlight the critical role of CEF-mediated exchange coupling in shaping low-energy spin dynamics, positioning rare-earth garnets as a cornerstone for future THz spintronic technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过太赫兹时域光谱实验，首次揭示了钆镱铋铁石榴石中Yb离子的晶场激发与Yb-Fe交换模式之间的杂化现象，并发现了反常的红移行为，表明晶场介导的交换耦合对低能自旋动力学起关键作用。
AI.motivation: 尽管稀土铁石榴石中晶场跃迁（CEF）和交换模式各自已被广泛研究，但二者之间的相互作用尚未被系统探索，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用温度依赖的太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）技术，研究Gd₃/₂Yb₁/₂BiFe₅O₁₂材料在不同温度下的光谱与时间域响应。
AI.result: 1) 观察到Yb离子CEF激发与Yb-Fe交换模之间的杂化，伴随光谱和时间权重在磁化补偿温度附近的显著重新分布；2) 发现Yb-Fe交换模在降温时出现反常红移（而非常规的蓝移），归因于Fe交换场与Yb CEF激发相互作用导致的交换各向异性变化。
AI.conclusion: CEF介导的交换耦合在低能自旋动力学中扮演关键角色，稀土铁石榴石有望成为未来太赫兹自旋电子技术的重要平台。

title: Soft-mode nonlinearities away from ferroelectric phase transition
summary: The interplay between ionic and electronic subsystems dictates the behavior of structural phase transitions in polar dielectrics, a coupling mediated by soft optical phonon modes. In incipient ferroelectrics such as SrTiO$_3$ (STO), strong local-field effects can drive the lattice into a non-perturbative regime near the phase boundary. However, disentangling the distinct contributions of local fields from those of spontaneous macroscopic polarization remains an experimental challenge. Here, we isolate these mechanisms by probing paraelectric STO deep within its symmetric phase, where macroscopic spontaneous polarization is suppressed. Linear terahertz (THz) spectroscopy reveals that the soft mode exhibits a hybrid character, predominantly driven by electronic polarizability. Utilizing two-dimensional THz spectroscopy, we map the underlying nonlinear signals, demonstrating that the system persists in a perturbative regime characterized by robust local-field coherence. By implementing a microscopic model of coupled electronic and lattice degrees of freedom mediated by local fields, we qualitatively reproduce these multidimensional coherent signatures. Our findings highlight that while local fields are necessary to initiate non-perturbative lattice dynamics, they are insufficient on their own. This reveals that spontaneous polarization plays a deterministic role in dictating soft-mode nonlinearities in strongly correlated polar dielectrics.

AI.tldr: 本工作通过太赫兹光谱实验与微观模型，揭示了在顺电相SrTiO₃中，局域场虽然能驱动非微扰晶格动力学，但仅凭局域场不足以产生强非线性响应，自发极化才是决定软模非线性的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 在极性介电体中，离子与电子子系统的相互作用决定了结构相变行为，但局域场效应与自发宏观极化各自对非微扰晶格动力学的贡献难以实验区分。本文旨在通过抑制宏观极化的顺电相体系，独立研究局域场的作用。
AI.method: 采用线性太赫兹（THz）光谱探测顺电相SrTiO₃的软模杂化特性，结合二维太赫兹光谱映射非线性信号，并构建电子-晶格自由度耦合的局域场微观模型，定性复现实验中的多维相干光谱特征。
AI.result: 软模表现出以电子极化率为主导的杂化特征；系统在微扰区域内保持强局域场相干性；局域场是触发非微扰晶格动力学的必要条件，但非充分条件；自发极化在软模非线性中起决定性作用。
AI.conclusion: 局域场本身不足以驱动非微扰晶格动力学，自发极化的存在才是决定强关联极性介电体中软模非线性行为的关键因素。
